title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 12 (DE) · „Meine Abendroutine für die Unterprothese“ – Kurz-Testimonial

shots.h3_prompt: She wears a soft grey fleece bathrobe. The tube keeps its exact shape and label, sharp and unchanged. One continuous shot from this exact first frame; keep the same people, faces, clothing, setting, background, lighting and colours for the whole clip. No new people, no extra hands.
